# Plivix Technologies

> Plivix Technologies builds custom ERP systems, web platforms, mobile apps and AI automation for growing companies in Bangladesh and worldwide. Registered in Bangladesh. Works in English and Bangla.

## Brand
The name Plivix joins two ideas: PLI = Progress, Logic & Innovation; VIX = Vision, Intelligence & X (unlimited possibilities).
Philosophy: "Progress through Logic, Innovation through Vision."

## What we do
- ERP and business systems: inventory, sales and CRM, purchasing, accounting and VAT, HR and payroll, production, POS, reporting.
- Web platforms and company websites (Bangla and English).
- Mobile apps for iOS and Android.
- AI automation, machine learning and data analytics.

## Products
- Plivix ERP: stock, sales, purchase and accounts in one system (4–8 weeks to go live).
- Plivix POS: billing for shops and multi-outlet retail, works offline (1–2 weeks).
- Plivix HR: attendance, leave and payroll with payslips (2–4 weeks).
- Plivix Store: online shop sharing stock with the ERP (2–4 weeks).

## Pricing (starting prices, USD, written fixed-price quotes)
- Company website: from $1,500
- Web or mobile app: from $6,000
- ERP suite: from $12,000
- Enterprise and custom: quoted per project
- Monthly support plans: from $150

## How we work
Discovery call, written scope and fixed quote, build in two-week sprints with working demos, then launch with training and support. Clients receive the source code and documentation.
